name: Bacterial Wilt (Leaf)
symptoms: Sudden wilting of leaves Yellowing and drooping of older leaves Brown discoloration in vascular tissue
description: A soil-borne bacterial disease causing wilting of leaves and stems, eventually killing plants. Can persist in soil and water for years.
management: Use resistant or tolerant cultivars Remove and destroy infected plants Improve soil drainage and avoid waterlogging Practice crop rotation with non-hosts
prevention: Use pathogen-free planting material Sanitize tools and equipment Avoid moving soil from infected fields
